newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Cesp to pay debt to Eletrobras - official.
newsitem.headline: Cesp to pay debt to Eletrobras - official.

text.p: Sao Paulo state power firm Cesp is planning to pay off part of its three billion real debt to federal holding Eletrobras by securitizing future privatization revenues, a top Eletrobras official said.

Speaking at a news conference, Eletrobras president Firmino Sampaio said negotiations between Cesp and Eletrobras were advanced. Cesp's debt accounts for 88 percent of the 3.4 billion reais in debt state power distributors owe to Eletrobras, he said.
Earlier this month, Cesp began negotiations with Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES) to securitize future privatization revenues of up to $3 billion.
Sampaio also said Eletrobras would hire soon two consultants to advise it on the sell-off of 20 hydroelectric and thermoelectric plants.
He noted, however, the model for the privatization of the electrical sector has been prepared by British Coopers & Lybrand consultants, which is expected to complete the work in eight months.
